common_window.basis: MEASURED intersection of required six symbols' bar ranges within target window

frozen_gate_rule.text: T12_MATERIALITY_V1 (frozen before any V8 scoring): a REQUIRED symbol fails the T12 gate iff, within the MEASURED common window, any of: (a) zero 15m bars; (b) zero funding settlements; (c) total unexplained gap time > 24h AND > 0.5% of window duration; (d) duplicate bar timestamps present. Non-required warnings do not flip the gate. Endpoints are measured from data and are NOT trimmed to dodge gaps.

held_exposure_proof.schema_addition: V8 sprint blocker B2 remediation (R-A2); additive to frozen T12_MATERIALITY_V1
held_exposure_proof.method: Earliest contract-compliant held exposure per symbol: readiness = MEASURED common-window start + max(warmup_min=14d, lookback) days (PLAN §5.1 warmup >= 14d binds for all frozen lookbacks 3/7/14D); signal cutoff = first Monday 00:00:00Z UTC at/after readiness; first possible fill = first COMPLETED 15m bar ts_event strictly AFTER the cutoff (signal/execution events separated); held exposure spans from that fill to terminal liquidation taken at the scored-window END (the widest possible held region — a stricter coverage test than any earlier final rebalance). All-six eligibility, purge/embargo and fold structure can only DELAY the first fill further, so this bound dominates every compliant execution of the frozen engine. Funding completeness is then required on [first fill, window end]: every modal-cadence slot anchored at the first published settlement must be present within ±2min; ANY missing slot inside that span overlaps held exposure -> T12_FAIL_FUNDING_COVERAGE. No window/threshold trimming anywhere.
